info.title: ProChat Workbench API
info.description: ProChat Workbench connects ChatGPT to guarded local project tools. Each action is bounded by a short Workbench deadline and returns compact structured JSON before platform timeouts.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer credential for Custom GPT Actions. Use the owner deployment Workbench Action Token. Do not use the scoped wbmcp_v1_ MCP credential, which is reserved for MCP authentication flows.

get.summary: Authoritative Workbench status and resume check
get.description: Read-only Workbench health, discovery, and resume state. Use include=active only for resume, continue, or current state requests; use include=sources only for explicit source discovery. It does not start execution. For known repository content, call readWorkbenchContext directly.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: For resume/current-state intent, use active. Use sources only for explicit source discovery; use all only when both are explicitly needed. The Action is read-only and does not start or resume execution.

200.description: Status with optional context (max 8 KB response)

post.summary: Bounded repo context read with an 8s Workbench deadline
post.description: Read bounded repository content/context. For known source IDs, call directly with that exact source and skip status. Prefer prepare_task_context for ordinary exploratory/multi-file work; use focused modes for known paths/symbols. Never use runWorkbenchCommand as a generic content preflight.

mode.description: Mode: prefer prepare_task_context for ordinary exploratory or multi-file work; it returns navigationEvidence and exactEvidence in one bounded packet. Use graph_context for explicit structure, exact modes for known paths/symbols. Persistent workflows use Workbench lifecycle.

sourceId.description: Required exact enabled source ID. Workbench Private maps to prochattools-workbench; resolve other labels to an exact enabled ID. If unknown, discover once with getWorkbenchStatus include=sources. Never substitute another repository or use placeholders such as default, workspace, current, or repo.

paths.description: At most 5 exact repo-relative paths for GPT use. For read_paths, enforced; for search_and_read, used as filter.

query.description: Concrete task goal or search query. Broad unscoped queries ("all", "repo", "code") fail fast with narrower-mode guidance. For graph_context, ranks fresh Codebase Memory files and symbols. For search modes, must be specific (e.g., "function name", "error message pattern").

path.description: Folder for list_files, or exact repo-relative file path for grep_context/read_range/read_symbol.

pattern.description: Literal pattern for grep_context. Regex is opt-in and tightly bounded; use literal mode for safety.

regex.description: If true, interpret pattern as a regular expression. Defaults to literal matching.

before.description: Lines before each grep_context match. Defaults to 8. Higher values = slower response.

after.description: Lines after each grep_context match. Defaults to 12. Higher values = slower response.

maxMatches.description: Maximum grep_context matches. Defaults to 5. Higher values = slower response.

startLine.description: First line for read_range. Output is capped at 250 lines to stay under 8s deadline.

endLine.description: Last line for read_range. Output is capped at 250 lines to stay under 8s deadline.

symbol.description: TypeScript class/function/const symbol for read_symbol. Fastest when symbol name is exact.

limit.description: Search/list result limit. Defaults to 5. Keep at 1-5 to finish under 8s deadline.

maxBytesPerFile.description: Exact read byte cap per file. Defaults to 4000. Files over 100 KB: use grep_context or read_range instead. Larger values slow down JSON serialization.

200.description: Files or search results (bounded to the GPT action payload limit)

post.summary: Guarded file change with an 8s Workbench deadline
post.description: Guarded file operations only. Lifecycle state, packets, leases, and continuation state are managed through supported Workbench lifecycle mechanisms.

sourceId.description: Required exact enabled source ID. Workbench Private maps to prochattools-workbench; resolve other labels to an exact enabled ID. If unknown, discover once with getWorkbenchStatus include=sources. Never substitute another repository or use placeholders such as default, workspace, current, or repo.

changeType.description: File mutation or bounded Workbench run-lifecycle operation.

content.description: Full file content for create/overwrite, appended text for append

find.description: Exact string to find for patch changeType

allowMultiple.description: For patch only, replace every identical match. Defaults to false.

reason.description: Why this change is being made (logged for audit)

confirmedByUser.description: Only set true when the user explicitly approved a confirmation-gated delete or write.

confirmationToken.description: Backend-issued confirmation token for confirmation-gated file changes.

dryRun.description: If true, validates the write policy without writing. Use to check if a path is allowed before writing.

goal.description: Complete bounded local goal for create_run. Include scope, expected outcome, constraints, validation, and explicit commit intent.

documentationPath.description: Optional repo-relative handoff path for create_run.

maxIterations.description: Optional bounded run iteration limit for create_run.

autoCommit.description: For create_run, enable only when the user explicitly requests an exact scoped commit.

runId.description: Exact durable Workbench run ID for resume_run or close_run; never infer it.

goalDispatch.description: One durable bounded goal packet. For a read-only goal set readOnly=true, provide bounded reads or commands, and set steps to []; for implementation include bounded mutation steps. Workbench performs the permitted reads, edits, validation, and explicitly authorized commit locally; do not issue per-command Actions.

scope.description: Bounded repository-relative scope: exact files or directory prefixes for this goal.

knownFiles.description: Optional files already known to be relevant.

knownSymbols.description: Optional symbols already known to be relevant.

nonGoals.description: Explicit work that must not be performed.

stopConditions.description: Conditions that stop local execution and produce a blocker.

confirmedByUser.description: Set true only when the user explicitly approved the exact goal scope and commit scope.

path.description: Repository-relative path inside the exact Workbench source.

args.description: For rg searches, use exact knownFiles as search paths whenever they are available; do not search whole scope directories because -m is per file and does not cap total output. Include -m 1 and --max-columns 200 before the pattern and search paths.

readOnly.description: Set true for a read-only goal. Read-only goals may and normally should use steps: [] when bounded reads or commands provide the work.

steps.description: Required packet step array. Use [] for a read-only goal; otherwise include only bounded mutation steps inside scope.

path.description: Repository-relative path inside the exact Workbench source.

to.description: Repository-relative path inside the exact Workbench source.

items.description: Repository-relative path inside the exact Workbench source.

packageDir.description: Repository-relative path inside the exact Workbench source.

authorized.description: Required true for a goal-level commit.

pushIntent.description: Recorded only; pushing is never performed by the goal packet.

post.summary: Diff, stage explicit paths, and commit within 10s
post.description: Three-step operation inside an active Workbench run session: git diff → git add paths → git commit. Use the exact sessionId returned by the run lifecycle and specific paths only; never commit everything at once. Confirmation-gated operations may require a second prompt with the returned token.

sessionId.description: Exact active session ID returned by the Workbench run lifecycle. Never infer it from sourceId.

sourceId.description: Required exact enabled source ID. Workbench Private maps to prochattools-workbench; resolve other labels to an exact enabled ID. If unknown, discover once with getWorkbenchStatus include=sources. Never substitute another repository or use placeholders such as default, workspace, current, or repo.

paths.description: Specific files to stage — never commit everything at once

message.description: Commit message, e.g. "fix: normalize path in read-context route"

confirmedByUser.description: Only set true when committing a confirmation-gated exact-path change the user explicitly approved.

confirmationToken.description: Backend-issued confirmation token for confirmation-gated commits.

post.summary: Run or track allowlisted command with a 12s GPT cap
post.description: Run allowlisted commands or validation jobs in an active session. Use only for explicit execution, validation, or evidence—not generic repository/content preflight. Submit returns resultRef; status pages results; evidence is redacted and owner-authorized; cancel requests cancellation.

sessionId.description: Exact active session ID returned by the Workbench run lifecycle. Never derive it from sourceId or invent one.

sourceId.description: Required exact enabled source ID locked to sessionId. Workbench Private maps to prochattools-workbench; resolve other labels to an exact enabled ID. Never substitute another repository or use placeholders such as default, workspace, current, or repo.

commandKind.description: Command kind. Use run_repo_shell for explicit normal repository tooling under the owner-scoped source boundary; use named kinds or run_exact_command for fixed contracts. Do not use commands as a generic content/status preflight; use readWorkbenchContext for repository content.

validationJobOperation.description: Submit, inspect, page, cancel, or explicitly retrieve a bounded redacted evidence record. Evidence retrieval requires the active session and matching owner proof; an evidenceId alone never grants raw access.

validationJobId.description: Stable persisted validation job ID and durable resultRef returned by submit. Reuse it for status, result paging, cancellation, and retry reconciliation.

validationJobTimeoutMs.description: Bounded persisted validation runtime. This is independent from the short GPT-facing HTTP timeout.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable submission key. Reusing it returns the same job; conflicting commands are rejected.

runId.description: Optional persistent Workbench run linked to the validation job.

packetId.description: Optional Workbench packet linked to the validation job.

taskId.description: Optional persistent run task linked to the validation job.

executable.description: Allowlisted executable for run_exact_command. Use only for explicitly allowlisted repository-supported deterministic operations. Never bypass Workbench commands, access secrets, install software, or perform unrestricted execution. Direct rg searches use structured argv with shell disabled.

args.description: Exact argument array for run_exact_command. Raw shell strings are not accepted; arguments remain structured, allowlisted, and session-bound.

nodeVersion.description: Require execution under an installed Node 20 runtime.

protectedPaths.description: Repository-relative paths that must not change during execution.

requiredBranch.description: Exact branch required before command execution. BuildFlow never switches branches automatically.

networkAccess.description: Validation commands default to no network access; n8n_workflow_export and migration prepare require true only for their fixed controlled operations.

outputPath.description: Fixed repository-relative rollback artifact path for n8n_workflow_export.

migration.description: Importer-safe migration projection. Runtime validation remains authoritative: it accepts only strict prepare, execute, or status combinations and rejects invalid field combinations.

marker.description: Test marker for run_package_test_marker. Shell metacharacters are rejected by the backend.

patternSet.description: Named security scan set for security_scan_paths.

packageDir.description: Required for run_package_script, run_package_test, and run_package_test_marker. Use "." for the selected source root.

confirmedByUser.description: Only use when the user explicitly confirmed a confirmation-gated safe command.

confirmationToken.description: Backend-issued confirmation token for confirmation-gated safe commands.

timeoutMs.description: GPT-facing command timeout. Defaults to 5-8s and is capped well below the external action timeout.

resultStream.description: For validationJobOperation=status, select the persisted redacted output stream to page.

resultCursor.description: Opaque source- and resultRef-bound continuation cursor returned by a prior result page. Omit to start at byte offset 0.

resultPageBytes.description: Bounded UTF-8 result window size for validation status, capped at 4000 bytes so the complete action remains under the 8 KiB response budget.

evidenceId.description: Opaque evidence reference returned in metadata. It is not a bearer credential and must be paired with the active session and matching owner authorization.

evidenceOwner.description: Optional owner binding copied from the returned metadata to prove task, packet, request, operation, provider, run, or session identity.

evidenceCursor.description: Opaque evidence continuation cursor. Reuse it with the same evidenceId and session; omit it to start at byte offset 0.

evidencePageBytes.description: Bounded UTF-8 evidence page size. Pages are redacted, integrity-checked, and capped at 4000 bytes.

command.description: Bounded shell command for normal owner-scoped repository work. Runs only within the selected source root or authorized temporary directory; pipelines, chaining, globs, and safe redirects are supported. High-risk system, secret, destructive Git, recursive-delete, and implicit network operations are blocked.

schema.description: Run owner-scoped repository shell commands or track durable validation jobs in an active session. Shell access is bounded, redacted, source-root contained, and denied for high-risk operations. Submit returns resultRef; status returns compact state or result pages; evidence returns a redacted page after explicit session/owner authorization. Heartbeats and SSE are unsupported.
